title: TMDB metadata
text: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Title metadata, cast, crew and user ratings are offline snapshots delivered by the Rust core from the mock API, not live scores. TMDB data and branding are not public-domain or Creative Commons artwork. Developer API use is non-commercial; commercial use needs separate permission.

title: Mock catalog
text: Jellyfin is not connected. Listing links show catalog presence, not streaming availability. Continue Watching progress, Up Next and addition order are simulated offline fixture state, not watch history or real provider state. No video files or playback are included. These films span family animation, adult comedy and horror; no age certification is implied.

title: Artwork
text: Artwork, portraits, character stills and the approved TMDB logo are served by the configured mock endpoint and loaded through the Rust core. Clients may crop artwork for display. Missing artwork may use abstract placeholders or initials; failed requests must not be replaced with fixture data.

title: Film & episode rights
text: Sprite Fright retains its original 2021 Blender release year. TMDB lists the same film as 2024-04-06; the snapshot preserves that provider date separately. The import verifies TMDB title 891761 through director Matthew Luhn and the official Blender film homepage, not a loose title/year match.

Public domain is jurisdiction-specific. Original film rights do not cover every restoration, new score, edition, poster, trademark or separate musical work. Verify edition and local rights before reuse. No license is asserted for the complete television series.

title: The Beverly Hillbillies
text: Included S01E01 ‘The Clampetts Strike Oil’ (1962-09-26) and S01E02 ‘Getting Settled’ (1962-10-03), not a complete season. Only these selected episode fixtures are included.
